title: Gemini, 500 CFA francs, Zodiac signs
descriptionPlain: Description Designed for women who seek luxurious jewerly Pendant-making ring for a stylish jewelry transformation Coin and elegant jewelry in one Gemini, an Air sign ruled by Mercury, symbolizes adaptability, sharp intellect, and a boundless curiosity about the world. This coin, made of finest silver, is a tribute to those who constantly seek inspiration and value mental flexibility. Its dynamic symbol perfectly reflects the essence of this sign. Gemini doesn’t ask who they are. They ask who else they can become. Wisdom of the Zodiac
